name: com.vngroundtruth/key-atlas
title: Key Atlas
description: Look up whether an API key for a service can be created via API/CLI, with steps and sources

tools.name: get_key_recipe
tools.description: Returns the recipe for creating an API key/token for a service: programmatic label (yes/conditional/no), steps, create_url, min_scope, gotchas, sources, tier (A API, B OAuth broker, C assisted browser recipe, D manual), automation (full|assisted|manual), recipe_json (data-only browser recipe for tier C, or null; it never contains or asks for a secret value), and commands to store the key in Bitwarden/n8n. Accepts a service id or name (for example "cloudflare-api-token", "OpenAI"). Text is English by default; pass lang="vi" for Vietnamese.

tools.name: check_config_leaks
tools.description: Explains how to scan config files (.env, mcp.json, n8n exports) for leaked keys with `npx keyatlas-scan .`, run locally on your own machine. This tool does NOT accept files or keys; never paste config contents into a chat.
